title: Touch panel error
fullDescription:
Electrolux range hoods report E1 when a touch input registers continuously. Grease film on the glass or condensation underneath are common causes.

Clean and dry the panel; replace if persistent.

title: Filter cleaning reminder
fullDescription:
E2 reminds users to clean the metal filters. The hood continues to operate but airflow drops.

Wash filters and reset timer.

fixSteps.title: Clean filters
fixSteps.instruction: Wash in hot soapy water; reset.

title: Blower motor fault
fullDescription:
E3 indicates the blower failed to reach commanded RPM. Bearings, capacitor, or driver could be at fault.

Disconnect power; rotate wheel by hand to test.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Spin blower wheel; replace if seized.

title: Light driver fault
fullDescription:
E4 indicates the LED driver protection has tripped. A failed LED module or harness short is the typical cause.

Replace the LED module per service manual.

title: Damper actuator fault
fullDescription:
E5 indicates the powered damper did not reach its end position in time. Inspect the duct path for obstructions and verify the actuator moves freely.

Replace actuator if dead.

faq.a: No, controller will keep flagging it.

title: Heat sensor over-temp
fullDescription:
E6 indicates the hood electronics or motor overheated. Restricted ducts and very high cooktop output can cause this.

Let the unit cool, check the duct path.

title: Communication fault
fullDescription:
E7 indicates the user interface lost communication with the main board. Reseat the harness; replace UI if needed.

Check for moisture damage.

title: Charcoal filter due
fullDescription:
C1 indicates the charcoal filter on recirculating models has reached its 6 month interval.

Replace and reset the indicator.

title: Capacitor fault
fullDescription:
FC indicates the AC motor capacitor is degraded; symptoms include slow start and humming.

Discharge before replacement.

title: Lock active
fullDescription:
LO indicates the child lock is on. Hold the lock icon to disengage.

Triggered by panel cleaning.
